email_access_grant_state_shape_check.name: email_access_grant_state_shape_check
email_access_grant_state_shape_check.value:
("app_auth"."email_access_grant"."state" = 'pending' and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."user_id" is null and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."claimed_at" is null and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."revoked_at" is null)
				or ("app_auth"."email_access_grant"."state" = 'active' and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."user_id" is not null and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."claimed_at" is not null and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."revoked_at" is null)
				or ("app_auth"."email_access_grant"."state" = 'revoked' and "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."revoked_at" is not null)
				or "app_auth"."email_access_grant"."state" = 'expired'

profile_account_deletion_owner_status_ch.name: profile_account_deletion_owner_status_check
profile_account_deletion_owner_status_ch.value:
("profile"."account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "profile"."account_deletion_requests"."owner_user_id" is not null)
				or ("profile"."account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'completed' and "profile"."account_deletion_requests"."owner_user_id" is null)

profile_account_deletion_lease_shape_che.name: profile_account_deletion_lease_shape_check
profile_account_deletion_lease_shape_che.value:
("profile"."account_deletion_requests"."lease_token" is null and "profile"."account_deletion_requests"."lease_expires_at" is null)
				or ("profile"."account_deletion_requests"."lease_token" is not null and "profile"."account_deletion_requests"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "profile"."account_deletion_requests"."status" = 'pending')
